name: XDKNet 2.5.11
body:
Android TV 2.5.11, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.1.0.10 (Emby 2.0.5.10).

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

This release is for admins. Nothing changes for other viewers.

## For admins: Radarr and Sonarr (Jellyfin)

- **Search what Radarr and Sonarr hold.** The Requests page has new Search
  and Missing views next to Requests. Search finds films and series by
  title, ignoring case, accents and a leading "The". Open a series to see
  its seasons and missing episodes, then search for an episode or a whole
  season, or pick a release yourself with interactive search.
- **See everything that's missing.** Missing lists the films and episodes
  Radarr and Sonarr are still waiting for, with episodes gathered under
  their series. Filter by films or series, monitored and aired, then pick
  titles to search for them together or go through interactive search one
  by one.
- **Search your requests.** A search box on the Requests page matches the
  title, year, who asked, and what needs attention, such as "stuck" or
  "not monitored".
- **Pick several downloads in the queue.** Tick downloads, or press Select
  on a TV, then remove the failed ones or take any download out of the
  queue. "Select all failed" picks every failed download the current filter
  shows. Filters cover failed imports, downloading and stalled, a show with
  several downloads is grouped under one heading, and common Radarr and
  Sonarr warnings get a short explanation in plain English.
- **Choose whether clean-up blocklists.** The automatic clean-up of failed
  downloads now has a "Blocklist the release" switch, on by default. Turn it
  off to remove failed downloads without stopping Radarr or Sonarr from
  grabbing the same release again.
- **Scroll bars on admin pages.** With a mouse, on the web or a computer,
  long admin pages such as the download queue now show a scroll bar.

Every removal asks first, shows the size, and is written to the XDKNet
plugin log with who did it.

Pair with plugin 2.1.0.10 (Emby 2.0.5.10).
